name: An Extraordinary Egg
summary: In Tanaris, Curgle Cranklehop seeks an extraordinary egg from Feralas.

sections.title: A Rarity from Feralas
sections.body: Curgle Cranklehop says few eggs from Feralas arrive in extraordinary shape. Such eggs are the rarest of all. One is what Curgle seeks.

faq.q: Who is looking for an extraordinary egg?
aliases: who gives an extraordinary egg quest
faq.answer: Curgle Cranklehop, inventor of the Super Egg-O-Matic, seeks an extraordinary egg.

faq.q: Where do these extraordinary eggs come from?
faq.answer: These extraordinary eggs come from Feralas, though few arrive in extraordinary shape.
This request follows The Super Egg-O-Matic.
